title.narrative: Model Infrastructure Support for the Soim Wokabout Joint Project in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: In support of increasing access of people, experiencing gender-based violence, to essential quality services, protection and justice, UNOPS constructs a safehouse including essential child-friendly service provision for gender based violence victims and a family to serve as model, that can be replicated and scaled up. The program is jointly implemented by UNFPA, UNWomen and UNOPS.
